container_note: V4 keeps the V3 content-addressed container byte for byte: the same eight record blocks, the same store, the same rehydration seam. S5G is an AUTHORITY migration, not a representation one.
evidence_not_authority: This manifest records what the migration did. It grants nothing and is not a source of truth for current state; the snapshot is, and the verifier checks it.
fixed_point_note: Three rounds, each declaring the live tip and committing that declaration: the declared value lagged the resulting tip by exactly one commit every time. A commit's SHA is computed from its content, so content cannot name the SHA committing it produces.
not_authorised_by_this_migration: candidate 006 design, configuration, planning or training
reading eval-v4, v5, v6 or v7 task bodies
promotion, activation, registry mutation, merge, tag or release
any change to candidate 004's HOLD or candidate 005's NOT_ELIGIBLE verdict

project_fields_dropped.master_commit: replaced by integration_authority.integration_base; the equality demand it carried is the fixed point
project_fields_dropped.merged_into_master: removed; a frozen boolean no check verified, now DERIVED as an observation

self_sha_note: Every commit identity a V4 record names must already resolve when the record is written. The migration tool refuses to emit otherwise, and a test refuses a declaration naming a commit that does not exist.
what_changed: AUTHORITY ONLY. project.master_commit (a live-equality demand) became integration_authority.integration_base (an immutable historical fact); project.merged_into_master (a frozen boolean no check verified) became a DERIVED observation; project.branch stopped being authority and lineage is now proved by ancestry, which a detached checkout cannot bypass.
why: Control Plane V3 could not represent its own master integration. check_git_authority required project.master_commit to EQUAL the live master ref, so a generation committed onto master invalidated the value it declared. That is a self-reference in the schema, not a Git problem: Git reported master a strict ancestor, the fast-forward available and the merge simulation clean throughout.
